items.title: Tree-Aware Posterior Distillation for Long-Horizon Agentic Reinforcement Learning
items.content: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards has become a scalable post-training paradigm for large language models. However, training agents over long-horizon interactions presents two challenges: using only terminal rewards makes turn-level credit assignment sparse and high-variance, while sequential mini-batch updates on a fixed rollout batch introduce policy staleness as the current policy drifts from the behavior policy. Existing approaches obtain denser credit via learned critics, proces

Addresses two long-horizon training challenges: sparse and high-variance turn-level credit assignment when using only terminal rewards, and policy staleness from sequential mini-batch updates drifting from the behavior policy. Discusses denser credit approaches via learned critics.
